map.节 = 0.5144 m/s。气压越低，最大风速越强。: Knot = 0.5144 m/s. The lower the pressure, the stronger the maximum wind speed.
💡 Atkinson-Holliday (1977): Vmax (knots) = 10.35×(1010-Pc)^0.615; 1 knot = 0.5144 m/s. The lower the pressure, the stronger the maximum wind speed.
map.Atkinson-Holliday 公式为西北太平洋热带气旋统计经验关系: The Atkinson-Holliday formula is a statistical empirical relationship for tropical cyclones in the Northwest Pacific
map.环境气压取 1010 hPa，对较弱系统估算偏高，仅供强度参考: The environmental pressure is taken as 1010 hPa; estimates are high for weaker systems and are for intensity reference only
map.台风等级按中国《热带气旋等级》GB/T 19201 标准（2分钟平均风）: Typhoon grades follow China's "Grades of Tropical Cyclones" GB/T 19201 standard (2-minute mean wind)
map.由近中心最大风速定台风等级（我国 12 级起）。: Determine the typhoon grade from the maximum wind speed near the center (from force 12 in China).
map.区分台风/强台风/超强台风。: Distinguish typhoon / severe typhoon / super typhoon.
map.预警信号与防御对应。: Match warning signals with defense measures.
map.近中心最大风速 Vms=40 m/s → 落在 32.7–41.4 → 13 级: Maximum wind near the center Vms=40 m/s → falls in 32.7-41.4 → force 13 (typhoon); Vms=55 m/s → ≥51.0 → force 16 (super typhoon).
map.12 级(≥32.7)黄色、14 级(≥41.5)橙色、16 级(≥51.0)红: Force 12 (≥32.7) yellow, force 14 (≥41.5) orange, force 16 (≥51.0) red; the super typhoon red is the highest level and requires comprehensive defense.
map.我国台风几级算台风？: From what force is a typhoon called a typhoon in China?
map.底层近中心最大风力 ≥12 级（≥32.7 m/s）称台风；热带风暴 8–9 级: A surface maximum wind near the center ≥ force 12 (≥32.7 m/s) is called a typhoon; tropical storm is force 8-9 and severe tropical storm force 10-11.
map.用飞机穿心或浮标/雷达反演，地面站常被眼墙破坏，定强以最大风速为准。: By aircraft penetration or buoy/radar retrieval; ground stations are often destroyed by the eyewall, so intensity estimation uses the maximum wind speed.
map.输入热带气旋中心最低海平面气压，依据 Atkinson-Holliday（197: Enter the tropical cyclone's minimum central sea-level pressure to estimate the maximum sustained wind speed near the center via the Atkinson-Holliday (1977) empirical formula and determine the intensity grade (TD/TS/STS/TY/STY/SuperTY) per China's "Grades of Tropical Cyclones" GB/T 19201.
